_comment: Tags excluded from default PR Maestro batches. Zephyr tier labels: detox/maestro/README.md.
_MM-T5611: Skip iOS: CI run 30000635898 — channel_bookmark_link_external.yml: tapping a link bookmark opens an external browser (SFSafariViewController) that did not return to the channel/Home tab. Re-checked 2026-08-09 for SEC-11018: this is a browser hand-off failure, NOT a server-connect/TLS failure — distinct from SEC-11051, so the SEC-11051 set-and-verify does not affect it. Stays iOS-excluded for its own reason. Keep Android coverage (Android exercises the long-press/options-sheet path, not the browser).
_MM-T3260: Skip Android: CI run 30331493720 (PR #9893, SHA 9f1496e) — help_url.yml failed with 'Unable to launch app com.mattermost.rnbeta' after ~136s (batch-7); already excluded on iOS for browser hand-off flakes. Chrome Custom Tab hand-off leaves the driver unable to relaunch the app on API 35.
_DIAGNOSIS_CORRECTION: The 'Assertion is false: id: tab_bar.home.tab is visible' failures below were NOT login failures. wait_for_server_connect_complete.yml marked the login-form wait optional and then asserted the home tab, so a failed SERVER CONNECT was reported with a login error message. Proof: on run 30466684108 the app issued ZERO /api/v4 requests and logged 'getServerUrlAfterRedirect error' — it never left the server form, so login.yml never executed. Two distinct connect causes were found: (1) TLS trust evaluation cancelled against a valid Let's Encrypt chain (NSURLErrorDomain -1200 + NSURLErrorFailingURLPeerTrustErrorKey, 'Cancelled during verify block' x4 in the red run, x0 in the green run 30437339535) while the runner itself reached the same host over HTTPS to seed data; (2) inputText dropped ~30 characters of SITE_1_URL, so the app connected to 'h-1-tjrchzrq.test.mattermost.cloud' and got 'hostname could not be found' (30447839548 batch-2). Before un-excluding anything below, re-read the sim log for these signatures — do NOT re-tune login.yml.
_MM-T1325: Skip iOS (SEC-11000): CI run 30334294934 — clock_display.yml failed 'Assertion is false: id: tab_bar.home.tab is visible' (~215s) = server CONNECT, not login (see _DIAGNOSIS_CORRECTION). Re-checked 2026-08-09 for SEC-11051: the dropped-keystroke connect cause is now caught by the set-and-verify in _enter_url_and_connect.yml (verified, see _SEC-11051_STATUS), so the residual is the TLS cold-start (NSURLErrorDomain -1200, 'Cancelled during verify block') — intermittent infra, not fixable app-side (OS trust evaluation); mitigated by _connect_check.yml warming trust. Keep Android coverage.
_MM-T67856_1_2: Skip iOS (SEC-11051): connect flake. Both flows PASSED on 30424009936 and FAILED on 30447839548 with identical code (same config, opposite outcomes) — failure 'Assertion is false: id: tab_bar.home.tab is visible' (~232-282s). See _DIAGNOSIS_CORRECTION: batch-1 was the TLS trust cancellation (NSURLErrorDomain -1200, 'Cancelled during verify block') and batch-2 was the dropped-keystroke URL corruption — neither a login flake; the login.yml retry/eraseText tuning targeted a subflow that never ran. Re-checked 2026-08-09: the dropped-keystroke cause (batch-2) is now caught at input by the SEC-11051 set-and-verify in _enter_url_and_connect.yml (verified, see _SEC-11051_STATUS), so the residual is the TLS cold-start alone — intermittent infra (red preflight in 31276319392, green full suite in 31281879487 on HEAD ab3cf5127). Stay iOS-excluded: they did NOT run in the one green HEAD Maestro iOS run (they're in this list), and un-excluding needs 3 consecutive green WITH them included, which requires TLS to be resolved/proven stable. Keep Android coverage — both pass there (~108-143s).
_SEC-11051_STATUS: SEC-11051 status (verified 2026-08-09; supersedes the prior 'set-and-verify MISSING' note — that was written before eb34dddaf landed it). (a) set-and-verify URL input: IMPLEMENTED (eb34dddaf) + VERIFIED. _enter_url_and_connect.yml does copyTextFrom server_form.server_url.input, evalScript (maestro.copiedText == SITE_1_URL), assertTrue after inputText and BEFORE Connect — gated on the RUNNING_E2E accessibility exposure in floating_input_container.tsx (accessible=false on the wrappers) + floating_text_input_label.tsx (accessibilityValue={text:value}) from 81fa213d9/82dfab3a1. Local verification on a booted iPhone 17 Pro E2E build (com.mattermost.rnbeta, RUNNING_E2E=true): copyTextFrom reads the controlled RN TextInput value; the assertion PASSED 3/3 on a correct URL and FAILED loudly on a truncated one (discriminating, not a no-op that always passes). CI: green Maestro iOS runs 31281879487 (HEAD ab3cf5127) and 31269069485 (82dfab3a12) both executed 'Copy text from element with id: server_form.server_url.input' + 'output.urlOk = (maestro.copiedText == SITE_1_URL)' and the suite was GREEN — disproving the prior note's worry that the assertion 'always fails and breaks the whole iOS suite'. (b) mislabel fix: SATISFIED by #9971 (wait_for_server_connect_complete.yml asserts non-optional notVisible:server_form.display_help FIRST, so a failed connect fails in connect context, not as 'tab_bar.home.tab is visible'). TLS cold-start (NSURLErrorDomain -1200, 'Cancelled during verify block'): now the SOLE residual connect cause — the dropped-keystroke cause (30447839548 batch-2) is caught at input by the set-and-verify before submit. Mitigated by #9971's _connect_check.yml (warms trust), NOT fixed; intermittent infra (red preflight in 31276319392, green full suite in 31281879487); not reproducible without an HTTPS Let's-Encrypt cloud server and not fixable app-side (OS trust evaluation). MM-T67856_1/_2 stay iOS-excluded (see _MM-T67856_1_2). SEC-11000 (MM-T1325): re-checked — see _MM-T1325. SEC-11018 (MM-T5611): re-checked — its iOS failure is browser hand-off (channel_bookmark_link_external.yml), NOT connect/TLS; SEC-11051 changes do not affect it (see _MM-T5611).
